finding: SAC converges to a reliable GRASP-ONLY policy; late stages do not consolidate.
durable_gain: reach and grasp both 1.00 [0.867,1.000] at two consecutive checkpoints, vs SFT 0.14 / 0.02

non_durable.explanation: only 2 of 25 conditions changed by >1.0 return between checkpoints. Medians are nearly identical (2.344 -> 2.333). The entire mean drop is condition 12 losing its single success (35.4 -> 2.3) and condition 19 losing its lift. The 138k lift/success rested on 2 and 1 conditions with CIs including zero, so this is regression to the mean, not a collapse.
non_durable.max_displacement: 0.3115 m -> 0.0236 m: the earlier success was an outlier the policy never consolidated

policy_is_not_degrading: grasp holds at 25/25 held-out and 10/10 in every recent training block, with stable returns. This is unlike both pilots, which fell to zero stages and negative return.
interpretation: SAC found and locked onto the grasp sub-goal, which the shaped reward pays reliably, and does not discover the much rarer lift->transport->place sequence from online experience alone within this budget. That is precisely the gap the RLPD demonstration prior is meant to close.
bearing_on_prediction: the pre-registered primary prediction -- RLPD reaches lift at fewer online interactions than SAC -- is now sharply testable: SAC has ~0 lift rate at 276k steps
